configuration.includeCode.description: Append the selected code as a fenced code block (tagged with the document language) below each copied location. Code is the snapshot taken when the selection was collected.
configuration.locationStyle.description: How copied locations are formatted. Lines and columns are 1-based; columns count UTF-16 characters, so a tab counts as one character and may differ from the `Col` shown in the status bar.
configuration.locationStyle.lineRange.de: Lines only, e.g. `src/app/foo.ts:12-14` (or `src/app/foo.ts:12` for a single line).
configuration.pathStyle.absolute.descrip: Always use the absolute file system path.
configuration.pathStyle.description: How the file path in a copied location is written.
configuration.pathStyle.workspaceRelativ: Path relative to the workspace folder, prefixed with the folder name in multi-root workspaces. Files outside the workspace fall back to the absolute path.
